shift.title: Adjust schedule
shift.unchanged: "Apply" is only available while the form has not changed since the preview. Please run the preview again.
shift.impossible: Cannot catch up — only {{max}} minutes of slack. Choose a later target slot.

error.withoutChange: The shift amounts to 0 minutes — nothing in the schedule would change. Please enter a number of minutes other than 0, or choose a start time that differs from the current one.
error.targetNotAfterStart: The target slot must come after the start slot on the same race day. Please choose a later slot from the list.
error.negativeDelay: Catching up needs a delay greater than 0 minutes — what is caught up is a delay. To move slots earlier, use the "+X minutes" method with a negative value.
error.leavesRaceDay: The shift would move "{{slot}}" to {{time}} and thus past the end of the race day. Please shift by less; the next day's schedule is adjusted separately.
error.leavesRaceDayNoSlot: The shift would move a slot to {{time}} and thus past the end of the race day. Please shift by less; the next day's schedule is adjusted separately.
error.leavesRaceDayPlain: The shift would move at least one slot past the end of the race day. Please shift by less; the next day's schedule is adjusted separately.
error.overtakesPredecessor: Cannot move that far ahead: the preceding slot starts at {{earliest}} and would be overtaken. Move up by at most {{max}} minutes — no shifted run may start before {{earliest}}.
error.overtakesPredecessorPlain: Cannot move that far ahead: the shifted block would overtake the preceding slot. Please move up by less.
error.overtakesFollower: Cannot delay that far: the next slot after the range starts at {{latest}} and would be caught up. Delay by at most {{max}} minutes — or choose a later 'up to' slot.
error.overtakesFollowerPlain: Cannot delay that far: the shifted range would catch up with the first slot after it. Please delay by less or choose a later 'up to' slot.
error.unexpected: The shift was rejected. Please check the values in the form and run the preview again.

help.plus: All slots from the selected slot onward are shifted by the given minutes (negative = move earlier).
help.range: Only the slots from the start slot up to and including the 'up to' slot are shifted by the given minutes (negative = move earlier). Everything before and after keeps its time.
help.setTime: The selected slot gets the new start time; all following slots keep their gaps.
help.compress: The given delay is caught up by the target slot: the gaps in between are shortened, and the target slot keeps its original time.
